{'text': '密歇根州民主黨參議員候選人阿卜杜勒·埃爾-賽義德（Abdul El-Sayed）對副總統JD·萬斯（JD Vance）最新一次人身攻擊的回擊，可謂地道密歇根式。', 'paragraph_context': 'Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed’s comeback to Vice President JD Vance’s latest personal attack on him was pure Michigan.'}

{'text': '萬斯周四出席在密歇根州門羅市為共和黨希望之星邁克·羅傑斯（Mike Rogers）舉行的2026年中期選舉造勢大會時，公開抨擊埃爾-賽義德。', 'paragraph_context': 'Vance went after El-Sayed during a 2026 midterm campaign rally in Monroe, Michigan, for GOP hopeful Mike Rogers on Thursday.'}

{'text': '萬斯在猛烈批評埃爾-賽義德時，指選民「值得比一隻小黃鼠狼更好的選擇，這隻黃鼠狼應該閉上嘴巴，對給予他一切的那個國家心存感激」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Vance, while slamming El-Sayed, said voters “deserve better than a little weasel who should shut his mouth and show a little gratitude to the country that gave him everything.”'}

{'text': '請看影片：', 'paragraph_context': 'Watch here:'}

{'text': '埃爾-賽義德在密歇根州馬凱特的一場活動上作出反擊。', 'paragraph_context': 'El-Sayed hit back during an event in Marquette, Michigan.'}

{'text': '他說：「總有幾個非常高調但眼界狹窄的人，想把我們也變得跟他們一樣狹隘。」', 'paragraph_context': 'There are “always a few very loud people who are small and want to make us small like them,” he said.'}

{'text': '他補充道：「他們就像推銷攤的小販，總是吵吵嚷嚷，其中太多人來自俄亥俄州」，明顯是在暗指萬斯的家鄉。', 'paragraph_context': '“They’re carnival barkers; you hear them, too many of them are Ohio,” he added, in a not-so-subtle reference to Vance’s home state.'}

{'text': '面對11月大選前鋪天蓋地的競選傳單、電話和短訊，你感到招架不住嗎？歡迎告訴我們——並分享你所收到的內容照片或截圖：jen.bendery@huffpost.com', 'paragraph_context': 'Drowning in political campaign mailers, calls and text messages ahead of the November elections? Tell us about it ― and share a photo or screenshot of what you’re getting: jen.bendery@huffpost.com'}

{'text': '隨後他直接向副總統喊話。', 'paragraph_context': 'Then he addressed the vice president directly.'}

{'text': '「你知道嗎，JD·萬斯今天叫我小黃鼠狼，挺好玩。我心想：『不不不，你說的應該是該死的狼獾才對。』」', 'paragraph_context': '“You know, It’s funny, JD Vance called me a little weasel today. I’m like, ‘No, no, no, what you’re talking about is a fucking Wolverine.’”'}

{'text': '埃爾-賽義德沐浴在掌聲中，喝了一口水後繼續說道：「你可以帶著你的七葉樹（Buckeye）滾到別處去。」', 'paragraph_context': 'El-Sayed soaked up the applause and, after taking a sip of water, continued: “You can take your Buckeye, and go shove it somewhere else.”'}

{'text': '然後他說：「俄亥俄。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Then he said: “Ohio.”'}

{'text': '埃爾-賽義德畢業於密歇根大學（University of Michigan），其校隊隊名為狼獾隊（Wolverines）；而萬斯則畢業於俄亥俄州立大學（Ohio State University），該校校隊是七葉樹隊（Buckeyes）。', 'paragraph_context': 'El-Sayed graduated from the University of Michigan, whose team name is the Wolverines, while Vance graduated from Ohio State University, home of the Buckeyes.'}

{'text': '狼獾隊與七葉樹隊是美國大學足球界其中一對最著名的宿敵。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Wolverines and Buckeyes enjoy one of college football’s biggest rivalries.'}

{'text': '他還說：「在這裡，我們可能是野貓隊，可能是斯巴達隊，可能是狼獾隊，但我們絕不會是七葉樹隊」，似乎在分別暗指密歇根州立大學（Michigan State University）的斯巴達隊和北密歇根大學（Northern Michigan University）的野貓隊。', 'paragraph_context': '“Here we might be Wildcats, we might be Spartans, we might be Wolverines, but we will never be Buckeyes,” he added, seemingly referring to Michigan State University Spartans and Northern Michigan University Wildcats.'}
